EvidenceType.description: What kind of evidence a result represents. Never inferred, always declared.
EvidenceType.title: EvidenceType

FileRef.description:
A file inside a known container (workspace, run or dataset directory).
Paths are relative POSIX paths; absolute paths and ``..`` are rejected so
a manifest can never point outside its container.
FileRef.title: FileRef

MetricValue.description:
One formal metric. ``value`` is only present when ``status`` is ``ok``
and is always finite; every other status carries a reason. This is how
"null / not applicable / failed / infinite" get explicit meanings and how
zero-filling of missing metrics is made impossible.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

PAReference.description: The frozen PA surrogate a DPD task trains or evaluates through.
PAReference.title: PAReference

ResolvedExperimentConfig.description:
Same shape as ``ExperimentConfig`` but every result-affecting default is
explicit, model parameters are complete, and the checkpoint selection
metric is set. Produced only by ``opendpd.services.config.resolve``.
ResolvedExperimentConfig.title: ResolvedExperimentConfig

RunEvent.description:
Append-only, strictly increasing ``seq`` per run. Clients resume from
the last ``seq`` they saw; when the server can no longer replay from that
point it answers with a snapshot requirement instead of guessing.
RunEvent.title: RunEvent

SignalReference.description: What the evaluated signal was compared against.
SignalReference.title: SignalReference

SignalSpec.description:
Signal metadata needed by evaluation profiles. Unknown values stay
``None``; they are never guessed. ``missing_for_legacy_evaluation`` names
what the legacy profile still needs.
SignalSpec.title: SignalSpec

SplitSpec.description:
Contiguous train/val/test split performed *before* framing, with an
optional guard band so overlapping frames never straddle a boundary.
SplitSpec.title: SplitSpec

TrainingConfig.description:
Defaults mirror the OpenDPDv2 recipe (arguments.py); they are the
single source of defaults for every entry point.
TrainingConfig.title: TrainingConfig

WorkerInfo.description:
Identity of the worker process. PID alone is never trusted: the
process creation time must match too (PIDs are recycled).
WorkerInfo.title: WorkerInfo

get.description: Download by *registered id* only; paths are never accepted from clients.

get.description: Server-Sent Events: ``id`` is the event seq; ``event: end`` closes a finished run.

Page through logs/worker.log by byte offset (safe for very large logs).

A trailing line without newline is returned only once the run has finished
(while running it may still be written).
